rc_comment: This variant was found in one SIDS case (of 201 tested). Expression in CHO cells generated IKs current with 40% smaller current density, which produced a partial loss-of-function phenotype.

Heterozygous variant identified in 40 year old African male who suffered sudden unexplained death. The variant is also present in 1/444 alleles from African individuals. Mouse knockouts (V206M/V206M) displayed significant prolongation of QT intervals.

Paper provides functional support for R46Q as gain-of-function.rnOther variants neutral in this in vitro assay.rnrnDSG2-p.K294E and -p.V392I, which have an arguable impact on ARVC pathogenesis and are predicted to be benign, did not show functional differences to the wild-type protein in this study. rnrnDSG2-p.D154E and -p.D187G, which were predicted to be damaging by bioinformatics tools, had no detectable effects on the DSG2 protein properties in our study.
In a human cell line HT1080 functional assay, this variant displayed no difference to wild type protein with respect to prodomain cleavage, adhesion properties and cellular localisation.

In yeast 2-hybrid assays, this variant resulted in loss of Talin 1 binding, as well as differential stretch-induced gene expression compared with wild-type in myoblastoid cell lines. Intracellular localization of mutant protein was not altered.
This variant identified in single patient but functional studies suggest no change from wildtype
We found that L567Q, N70K, E439K, G552R, E555K, A647D, R965H, E1053K, S1140T, L1501V, rnG1502S, and E1938K produced a reduction in sodium current density upon co-expression rnwith WT. Others did not.
